title: 2026 F-gas air-conditioning and heat-pump product-ban QA

sources.title: Bans on F gas in new products and equipment: current and future
Fluorinated gas (F gas): guidance for users, producers and traders

facts.source_fact: HFCs above GWP 150 are banned in all new cars.
HFCs above GWP 150 are banned in movable air-conditioning equipment that users can move between rooms.
From 2025, F gases above GWP 750 are banned in single-split systems containing less than 3kg refrigerant.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve start year, GWP and mass thresholds.

facts.source_fact: Single-split systems are described as one cooling coil connected to a remote condensing unit.
Larger air-conditioning or heat-pump systems such as chillers or larger split systems are outside that specific single-split ban.
The product-ban guidance concerns placing equipment on the market in Great Britain.
The ban status must not be inferred solely from the presence of an F gas; equipment type and GWP thresholds matter.
The guidance distinguishes current bans from future-dated bans.
A product-ban breach may result in a civil penalty.
Ban classification is not an emissions measurement.
